sources: recreation.gov public search API per-site catalog for facility 233929 (catx.py), read 2026-10-22

values.note: $26 a night per single site, covering 2 vehicles (or an RV/trailer with its tow vehicle); each extra vehicle $9 a night. Group site $75. Firewood $10 a bundle. The Forest Service page also still shows an older '$20 / $8 extra vehicle' line.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233929/rates (Peak Season 2026-05-15 to 2026-09-26: STANDARD NONELECTRIC 26, GROUP STANDARD NONELECTRIC 75) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/pine-creek-campground ('Single Site: $26 per night Additional Vehicle Fee: $9 per night') + recreation.gov notices ('Camping fee covers 2 vehicles or RV/Trailer with tow vehicle. An extra vehicle fee of $9.00', 'Firewood is available on site for $10.00 a bundle'), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: recreation.gov per-site catalog for 233929 (catx.py: every site NONELECTRIC; Water Hookup 'No' on all 27), read 2026-10-22

values.note: recreation.gov lists 27 units: 23 standard sites, a tent-only and a walk-to site, an overnight group site (26) and a day-use group picnic area (28). Two are pull-through. Average trailer/RV parking spur 16 x 50 ft; recreation.gov's driveway lengths run 18-60 ft but it gives no max vehicle length. The road in is narrow and winding.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/pine-creek-campground ('Camp sites: 25', 'Trailer/RV Sites Average Parking Spur: 16’ x 50’', 'Pine Creek Rd (narrow winding road)') + recreation.gov per-site catalog (catx.py: Driveway Entry 2 Pull-Through, Driveway Length 18-60), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Trash collection and recycling; accessible fishing dock and a half-mile accessible Creekside Trail in the campground. On-site host.

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233929 ('vault toilets, drinking water and trash collection', notices 'There are NO Shower facilities available at this campground', 'No RV Dump Station is located in any of the USFS campgrounds managed by ExplorUS in the Custer-Gallatin National Forest', 'An accessible fishing dock is located within the campground') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/pine-creek-campground ('Vault toilet(s)', 'Potable water is available at this site'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Forest Service 'Seasons of Use: 5/15 – 9/25. Weather Dependent.'

Every unit is reservable on recreation.gov (the Forest Service page links 'Make Reservations Here'); reservations close 3 days before arrival and reserved sites are held until check-out time the day after arrival. Concessionaire-run (ExplorUS).

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233929 (rules: maxConsecutiveStay 16, reservationCutOff 3; notice 'Reserved campsites will be held until check-out time on the day following your scheduled arrival'; facility email @goexplorus.com) + recreation.gov per-site catalog (all 27 reservable) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/pine-creek-campground, read 2026-10-22

note: Custer Gallatin NF (Yellowstone RD) campground in Paradise Valley ~13 mi S of Livingston, under mature Douglas fir and spruce at the foot of the Absarokas, beside the Pine Creek trailhead (Pine Creek Falls 1 mi, Pine Creek Lake 5 mi). Few pull-throughs and hairpin curves on the access road; reviewers advise nothing much over ~28 ft. No horses in the campground. --Claude
summary: Concessionaire-run (ExplorUS) for the Forest Service (Yellowstone RD); all sites reservable on recreation.gov. Confirmed $26 (2026), no electric, vault toilets, drinking water, no showers, pull-throughs, reservable on recreation.gov; changed count 27->25 (FS 'Camp sites: 25'); added no dump, season 05-15 to 09-25, 16-night limit. Not stated: max rig length (only driveway lengths and a 16x50 average spur), booking window (inherited 180). Note trimmed of restated values.
